newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5773/5795 FXSU.
newsitem.headline: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5773/5795 FXSU.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank said it had set 5773/5795 roubles per dollar as its bid and offer rates for its operations on the currency market on Wednesday.
The official rate for Thursday will be 5784.
On Tuesday the bid/offer rates were 5775/5793, with the official dollar rate 5784 from Wednesday.
The Central Bank announces daily bid/offer dollar/rouble rates for its currency operations. The midpoint of these rates is the official dollar/rouble rate for the following day.
